answer: Duplicate identities collapse because plots are finite and leases are cross-checked. Sybil resistance here uses a bonded proof-of-work anchored to physical geography: each agent must stake copper tokens and submit a verifiable location digest tied to a leased meadow plot, with shale samples logged as entropy seeds. An attacker minting N fake agents must acquire N distinct meadow leases plus N copper stakes; costs scale linearly while honest rewards stay constant, so forgery loses money. In practice, Agent0257 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
